description: Three implicit identities under the 'exact' claim: capture↔review source-path string equality (F8 — nil source and path mismatch both collapse to uncovered), no_debug_info_mfas conflating three states while sitting in the closure pct denominator (F11), and two independently derived module-scope caches where a file_map miss silently deletes lines from payload AND remainder (F23). Also F18: missing :attribution renders as :exact — unknown provenance must render unqualified. Specify path identity (repo-root-relative, normalized both sides), classify unresolvable sources as their own partition, single-source the module scope + surface misses as meta.unmapped_modules. Report Theme 4.
title: Specify the capture↔review identity joins; stop failing silently toward stronger claims (F8, F11, F23, F18)
